title: Ensuring Accurate Declarations by Traders and Logistic Firms that Goods Transshipped through Singapore Do Not Become Singapore-origin Goods
what_it_is: Ensuring Accurate Declarations by Traders and Logistic Firms that Goods Transshipped through Singapore Do Not Become Singapore-origin Goods

sections.label: Singapore Tier 3 transshipment report
sections.summary: The report placed Singapore in Tier 3, countries with low illegal transshipment volumes but attractive to opportunistic re-routing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In the report, Singapore was placed in the Tier 3 list of countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Countries in this tier were characterised as having low absolute illegal transshipment volumes but possessing features that make them attractive opportunistic targets for re-routing.

sections.label: Accurate origin declarations enforcement
sections.summary: Customs declarations must be accurate, transshipped goods cannot be declared Singapore-origin, and Singapore Customs enforces this.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: All customs declarations, including transshipment permit applications, are required to be accurate and truthful under the Customs Act, and the Regulation of Imports and Exports Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Goods that are transshipped through Singapore, without undergoing substantial transformation locally, cannot be declared as Singapore-origin goods.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In June 2025, Singapore Customs issued a Circular to all traders and declaring agents reiterating the importance of accurate "Country/Region of Origin" declarations in their permit applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: For instance, on 14 August this year, Singapore Customs charged a company and three individuals for their alleged involvement in a scheme to falsely declare the origin of bedding products and other goods exported from Singapore to the US, in an apparent attempt to circumvent import duties imposed by the US.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Singapore places great importance on our reputation as a trusted and reliable business hub and we will act decisively to preserve it.
